userConstraint: Continue code first. No Gradle/Java compilation, tests, native DLL execution/emulation, client launch, save changes or media playback.
scope: Six Greene weapon programs / thirteen original Shoot tracks

greene.animation: Synced program identity selects the same original clip slices for visible pose, receiving skin, muzzle position and direction. Existing move IDs and projectile ID are retained; greene_projectile is a separate new registration.
greene.firing: Ten persistent per-socket cooldowns, one spawn attempt per 20 Hz update, successful spawn only consumes cooldown; original fire-rate is not an inner pellet batch. Half-open Shoot windows have a documented 20 us boundary tolerance.
greene.direction: Actual weapon GameObject context, empty-joint fallback and attached Mouth basis established by native instruction traces. Parent scale/shear affects position; original Gram-Schmidt final attachment basis determines direction.
greene.flight: Six native profiles: no vanilla gravity/drag; braking, acceleration, delayed tracking, lateral friction, lifetime and displacement range are retained. A synced float vector avoids the vanilla velocity-packet 3.9-block/tick cap for source 80-unit/s shots.
greene.collision: Source thickness is a swept-sphere radius. Analytic sphere-to-affine-cuboid first contact checks block shapes, animated regions and articulated vehicle boxes. Real blocks win ties; owned body parts do not block their own missile. Entire swept volume must already be loaded and inside the border.
greene.proximity: Strict original-target-origin trigger ends the missile. Until original projectile final-action template bodies are available, a stated MC fallback delivers single-target damage only through an unobstructed real target surface; it never creates an area blast. Mounted targets drop stale living guidance.
greene.acquisition: Four on-foot states use an explicit MC cycle. Tank/aircraft attacks require the matching occupied hostile hull and crew protections. Empty parked hulls and unrelated on-foot targets cannot satisfy anti-vehicle gates.
greene.damage: Living base damage = original player/NPC field * .06 (preserves previous rifle base6 at source100); mechanical hits use source NPC field through existing armor/protection rules. Native force and friendly-fire behavior are not claimed.
greene.presentation: Existing slime item and licensed biological Foley are placeholders. One windup cue and one release cue per newly firing Shoot track, coalesced across simultaneous ports. Original missile meshes/trails/spin/audio remain unresolved.
greene.lifecycle: Breaking defenses, disabled actor, removed or invalid target cancel remaining requests. Already released valid missiles retain their lifetime. Socket cooldowns and on-foot selector save/load separately; attacks resume idle after load.

goliath.integration: GoliathGroundImpact runs after the posed body update on every committed tick, including 39/40/41 after contact38. A target killed by contact38 does not cancel the follow-up ground effect; actor death/disable/exposure still cancel.

goliath.remaining: Native giant fist/support-plane penetration and other moves/AI remain unresolved.
